Violation Details
Regulation Code
Reference		Violation & Comments
8-201.13
(A-B) HACCP plan not submitted prior to engaging in activity where required.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Before engaging in an activity that requires a HACCP plan, a permit applicant or permit holder shall submit to the regulatory authority for approval a properly prepared HACCP plan as specified under § 8-201.14 and the relevant provisions of this Code. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 90 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: No HACCP plan on file prior to engaging in cook chill and ROP
6-501.14
(All) Ventilation systems not maintained clean; ventilation system creating a nuisance or health hazard outside.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of food is exposed such as after closing. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 90 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Ventilation grates are greasy above the grill, can drip onto food below. Ventilation grates in walk in cooler are fuzzy, can contaminate food cooling in the walk in cooler.
3-502.12
(B 1-3 & 5-7) (D) (E, 2-4) Reduced oxygen packaged food procedures such as sous vide, cook chill food or packaging of cheese not properly implemented.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: A food establishment that packages time/temperature control for safety food using a reduced oxygen packaging method shall implement a HACCP plan that contains the information specified under ¶¶ 8-201.14 (B) and (D) and includes requirements from §3-501.12 (B ) 1-7. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 10 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: ROP packaging of cook chill chili verde observed defrosting in walk in cooler. Says it was sealed 11/1. No HACCP plan on file for cook chill.
3-501.16
(A) Inadequate hot holding of PHF/TCS food.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Except for roasts, which can be held at 130 degrees F after cooking, potentially hazardous/time-temperature control for safety food that is being held hot must be held at 135 degrees F or above. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 3 days
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Observed sausage links on hot hold being double stacked and on metal tray. The top row of sausage links was below 135 and the ones on the rack as well, sausage links directly touching the pan were above 135F
3-304.12
(All) In-use utensil not stored in a safe manner.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, utensils shall be stored: a) in non-TCS food with their handles above the top of the food; b) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain; c) on a clean surface if washed rinsed, and sanitized as required; d) in a clean container; or e) in water maintained at 135F or higher. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 90 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Observed measuring cup being used as scoop in rice, handle touching rice. Observed knife being stored in sanitizer bucket in between uses.
3-501.16
(A & B) Cold time/temperature control for safety food not adequately temperature controlled.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Except for raw shell eggs, which can be held at 45 degrees F, potentially hazardous/time-temperature control for safety food that is being held cold must be held at 41 degrees F or lower. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 3 days
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: single door reach in cooler, observed temperatures above 41F; items need to be discarded that have been out of temperature for over 4 hours. Observed water on bottom shelf in cooler. Cooler will need to be serviced
4-501.114
(All) Sanitizer wiping cloth bucket not readily available during operation OR made at a weak concentration.
Corrected On Site
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Sanitizer at an effective concentration for sanitizing equipment in place and for wiping up food spills must be available at all times of operation. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 3 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: No sanitizer bucket set up; COS=sanitizer bucket made when notified
3-301.11
(A-E) Direct hand contact when handling ready-to-eat foods.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTIONCorrected On Site
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Food employees may not contact exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Must be corrected within 3 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Observed employee cutting up a strawberry to go on yogurt bowl with bare hands; COS=stopped employee and discussed RTE foods can not be handled with bare hands, they must be handled with gloves or utensils
3-501.18
(A & B) PHF/TCS food not discarded if it is not date marked, it exceeds the allowable use by period or if it has been time/temperature abused.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Ready-to-eat, potentially hazardous/time-temperature control for safety food must be discarded if it exceeds allowable time and temperature controls or is in a container that does not bear adequate date marking. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 3 days
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Multiple items have passed their 7 day date mark, those items need to be discarded; Observed 11/1, 11/3, Chili in walk in cooler-date marked 10/31
